name: urban-heat-analytics-root
description: Urban Heat & Human Activity Analytics - A Data-Driven Heat Exposure Risk Assessment System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
